name: thorkc-site
description: Model Context Protocol manifest for thorkc.com — AI-assisted editing, Journal orchestration, and site management via GitHub.

tools.name: list_journal_entries
tools.description: Return all Journal entries from journal/_index.json

tools.name: create_journal_entry
tools.description: Scaffold a new Journal entry using journal/_template.html

tools.name: publish_journal_entry
tools.description: Set status=published in journal/_index.json for a given slug

tools.name: get_site_status
tools.description: Return section live-status and last-commit info

tools.name: edit_section_index
tools.description: Open the index.html for a given section for editing

tools.name: update_global_nav
tools.description: Patch nav links across all section index pages

auth.note: Set GITHUB_TOKEN in your MCP client env to enable write operations.
